label: HOA compliance notice – parking violation
subject: OFFICIAL COMPLIANCE NOTICE – Parking Violation
body:
OFFICIAL COMPLIANCE NOTICE

From: Sunrise Ridge Homeowners Association
Date Issued: March 15, 2026
To: Property Owner, 42 Sunrise Ridge Drive, Unit C
Subject: Parking Violation — Unauthorized Vehicle Storage

Dear Property Owner,

This is an official Compliance Notice issued by the Sunrise Ridge Homeowners Association (HOA) regarding an observed violation of Section 6.3(b) of the Sunrise Ridge Declaration of Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions (CC&Rs).

Nature of Violation: An inoperable or stored vehicle (a 2008 Honda Civic lacking current registration and with a flat tire) has been parked continuously in designated guest parking space G-7 for more than seventy-two (72) consecutive hours, in violation of community parking rules which prohibit the storage of non-operational vehicles.

Required Action: You are required to either (1) remove the vehicle from the property or (2) provide written documentation to the HOA Management Office proving the vehicle is operational and currently registered — no later than April 1, 2026.

Consequences of Non-Compliance: Failure to comply by the stated deadline of April 1, 2026 may result in the vehicle being towed at the registered owner's expense and a fine of $250 being assessed against your account.

Please contact the HOA management office at (925) 555-0117 or hoa@sunriseridge.org if you have questions or wish to formally dispute this notice. Appeals must be submitted in writing within fifteen (15) days of this notice.

Board of Directors
Sunrise Ridge Homeowners Association
